definition.name: suite1-reborn-main-38858846-stock
definition.owner_authorization: 2026-11-19: the owner agreed to a sanity rerun of Suite 1 on current main (borg-zoo#183), after borg-reborn-rs #600 (lava and staircase fixes, shipped on) and #607 (the harness plays the borg-rs core by default) changed main's defaults: Suite 1 on borg-reborn-rs main 38858846 with its own default settings, stage by stage to full.
definition.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-19, before any result was read (borg-zoo#183). A sanity check of main: the 999 saves of
Suite 1 with its protocol (exact 2,000-engine-turn horizon, the suite's 30-second native wall limit, fresh Borg
memory, saved engine RNG). Settings: the checkout's own harness/borg.txt (sha256 3ce9ae4f...), nothing
overridden; the scary list it names (scary_monsters.txt d045111b...) is frozen with the inputs and read by
absolute path. The first smoke (run 44436640586) failed its gate because the runner did not stage that file
(fixed in #346). Stages smoke 18, small 90, medium 360, big 900 and full 999 run in sequence, each after the previous
stage's gate. Gate at every stage: no missing, invalid or stopped cell; one binary; every cell's native receipts
show the save, the RNG, the borg-rs core, every borg.txt setting written, every borg_param_* effective from
borg.txt, and an initial pack/equipment/rune hash equal to the suite's. Reported alone: the death share, deaths
per class and every scenario's outcome. Encounters from one life are correlated.
definition.question: How does borg-reborn-rs main 38858846, with its own default settings, play the 999 saved encounters of Suite 1?
